workflow: worktree isolation via Agent tool is unreliable for merge-back in a strict fail-closed crypto phase — the orchestrator switched to sequential gsd-executor subagents on the main feature branch to guarantee clean per-plan STATE/ROADMAP updates.
A mid-execution compile error diagnostic can be a stale mid-edit snapshot; always verify with a fresh cargo check before treating it as a blocker.

Executor subagents sometimes exceed their declared scope (60-01 folded arms that were 60-04's declared work); downstream plans must re-verify their preconditions rather than assuming prior plans stayed in scope.
